paper.title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators

results: Transcribed from Tables 1 and 2 of the supplied preprint; uncertainty values preserved as printed.
curricula: Operative subgoal and final-goal wording reproduced verbatim from Appendix D. Editorial stage titles are retained as provenance but are not rendered.
evidence_note: LLM judgments and computational evaluation do not establish experimental activity or clinical efficacy.

interactiveCharts.source: Saved aggregate data for Figure 7(c,d), verified against the supplied figure. Goal 3 Figure 7(b) data and source receipts were supplied in the author verification handoff; its top-100 training-SMILES reference is recorded separately from Goal 4.

resultPanels.source: Natural-language Goals 1–5 and the reported Goal 5 discovery example in the supplied preprint.
resultPanels.context: Brief task context, direct proxy rewards, and teacher-observable lists checked against Appendix D; page references are stored per goal.

candidateTraces.fields: Only explicit structured goal explanations, final-output judgment rationales and critical_unknowns, candidate sequence/SMILES, and selected observed descriptors. Provider reasoning metadata is excluded.
candidateTraces.selectionPolicy: Editorial illustrative selection for consistent goal-specific explanations and size diversity; not a random sample, causal control, or validated activity ranking.
candidateTraces.additionalSources: Goal 3 and Goal 5 verbatim records and archive SHA-256 receipts supplied in the author verification handoff; the original archives are not bundled with the website.
